content_sections.heading: Allahabad University Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the Allahabad University Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download Allahabad University Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.text: Faculty: Rs. 45,000/- per month Professional Experts: Rs. 1,500/- per lecture (max Rs. 50,000/- per month)

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Allahabad University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive is being conducted by Allahabad University for its B.A.LL.B.(Hons) Five Year Integrated Course.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies available for Faculty and Professional Expert positions under this notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the designated venue on the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q4. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 14 October 2026 at the New Building of the Faculty of Law, University of Allahabad.

faq.question: Q5. What are the post names offered in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The posts include Faculty (in Law Subjects) and Professional Experts having experience of a minimum of 10 years of practice in Law.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Faculty position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Faculty position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 45,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the remuneration for Professional Experts?
faq.answer: Professional Experts will be paid Rs. 1,500/- per lecture, subject to a maximum limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the interview?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee is Rs. 500/- for UR, EWS & SEBC, Rs. 200/- for SC & ST, while PwDs and female candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q9. What qualifications are required for the Faculty position?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Faculty position must possess qualifications as per UGC Regulations, 2018.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification and application form by visiting the official website of Allahabad University at www.allduniv.ac.in.
